name.zh: 西弗吉尼亚 20 号公路

tagline.en: Bluefield to New Martinsville, the state's longest route, two lanes throughout
tagline.zh: 自布卢菲尔德至新马丁斯维尔，全州最长路线，全程双车道

start.zh: 布卢菲尔德附近布卢韦尔的 US 52

end.zh: 新马丁斯维尔附近的 WV 7

en: WV 20 is the longest route in the West Virginia state system. The Division of Highways puts it at 253.4 miles from Bluefield to New Martinsville, and it crosses ten counties doing it: Mercer, Summers, Fayette, Greenbrier, Nicholas, Webster, Upshur, Barbour, Harrison and Wetzel.

Despite the length it has essentially no multilane sections. It is a two-lane road the whole way, following creek bottoms and climbing over ridges, and it is repeatedly cut off by the Interstates rather than fed by them — I-77 and I-64 both cross it without the sort of interchange that would send traffic onto it.

It crosses the New River at Hinton, runs with WV 15 through Webster Springs, meets US 33 and US 119 at Buckhannon, and reaches Clarksburg before turning north-west through Shinnston and Wallace to finish near New Martinsville on the Ohio.
zh: WV 20 是西弗吉尼亚州道系统中最长的一条。公路局将其定为自布卢菲尔德至新马丁斯维尔 253.4 英里，途中跨越十个县：默瑟、萨默斯、费耶特、格林布赖尔、尼古拉斯、韦伯斯特、厄普舍、巴伯、哈里森与韦策尔。
尽管里程可观，它基本没有多车道路段。全程都是双车道，沿溪谷而行、翻越山脊；州际公路一再把它切断，而不是向它输送车流——I-77 与 I-64 都横穿而过，却没有那种能把车流引上来的互通。
它在欣顿跨越新河，与 WV 15 共线穿过韦伯斯特斯普林斯，在巴克哈嫩与 US 33、US 119 相交，抵达克拉克斯堡后转向西北，经欣斯敦与华莱士，最终在俄亥俄河畔的新马丁斯维尔附近结束。

en: The instructive failure on WV 20 happened in the middle of a town. In June 2022 a large sinkhole opened along the route in Hinton, near the police department, after an old underground drainage structure collapsed.

The repair took three attempts. WVDOH crews put in a temporary drainage structure and filled the hole; heavy rains washed that out in November 2022; crews then installed a temporary bridge to span the hole, and in January 2023 filled it with enough rock and dirt to fill an Olympic-size swimming pool as a holding measure.

The permanent fix went to bid on 12 September 2023 under the state's Roads to Prosperity bond programme. Contractors will bore a new hole under WV 20 and install a new pipe to carry Brier Branch beneath the road — a permanent rerouting of the stream and closure of the old structure, after which the temporary bridge comes out and the road is repaved.
zh: WV 20 上最具说明性的一次失效发生在镇子中央。2022 年 6 月，欣顿的这条路上、警察局附近，因一处老旧的地下排水结构坍塌而出现了一个大型塌陷坑。
修复尝试了三次。西弗吉尼亚公路局的工班先安装了临时排水结构并回填坑洞；2022 年 11 月的暴雨把它冲毁；工班随后架设临时桥跨越坑洞，并于 2023 年 1 月以足以填满一座奥林匹克游泳池的石料与泥土回填，作为过渡措施。
永久性修复于 2023 年 9 月 12 日在该州「通往繁荣之路」债券计划下招标。承包商将在 WV 20 下方钻孔并安装新管，将布莱尔支流引至路下——这是溪流的永久性改道并封闭旧结构；此后临时桥拆除，道路重新铺面。

en: The Buckhannon-to-Webster Springs section is the one riders single out, and the reason is the alignment: about fifty-five miles of near-continuous curve through the hills of the state's centre, with no towns of consequence in between.

Services are the constraint. Buckhannon at the north end and Webster Springs at the south end are where you eat and fuel; between them the road is in the woods. The same is broadly true of the Summers and Greenbrier county stretch around Hinton and Rainelle.

Surface quality varies by district rather than by route — WV 20 crosses ten counties and the condition changes with them. Slip and slide repair is a standing WVDOH programme in this part of the state, and Webster County sites appear on the department's published repair lists regularly.
zh: 骑手们单独挑出来的是巴克哈嫩至韦伯斯特斯普林斯一段，理由在于线形：约五十五英里近乎连续的弯道，穿行于该州中部的丘陵之间，其间没有像样的城镇。
限制在于服务设施。北端的巴克哈嫩与南端的韦伯斯特斯普林斯是吃饭与加油的地方；两者之间，路在林子里。欣顿与雷内尔一带的萨默斯县与格林布赖尔县路段大体亦然。
路面质量随管养区而非随路线变化——WV 20 跨越十个县，路况也随之改变。滑坡与塌方修复是该州这一带西弗吉尼亚公路局的常设项目，韦伯斯特县的工点经常出现在该部门公布的修复清单上。

value.en: 253.4 miles, Bluefield to New Martinsville — the longest route in West Virginia
value.zh: 253.4 英里，自布卢菲尔德至新马丁斯维尔——西弗吉尼亚最长的路线

figures.source: WVDOH, West Virginia Transportation Data Pocket Reference

value.en: Opened June 2022; temporary repair washed out November 2022; permanent fix bid 12 September 2023 under Roads to Prosperity
value.zh: 2022 年 6 月出现；临时修复于 2022 年 11 月被冲毁；永久修复于 2023 年 9 月 12 日在「通往繁荣之路」计划下招标

figures.source: WVDOH press release, 'WVDOH accepts bids to permanently fix Hinton sinkhole, 29 other projects', 2023

why.en: WVDOH accounts for spending by project and by district rather than by route, and no figure for building WV 20 as a whole has been published.
why.zh: 西弗吉尼亚公路局按项目与管养区核算支出，而非按路线；并未公布修建 WV 20 全线的费用。

why.en: WVDOH's pocket reference gives the route's length but does not summarise lane configuration by route, and no agency statement on the extent of multilane sections could be verified.
why.zh: 西弗吉尼亚公路局的袖珍手册给出了路线长度，但未按路线汇总车道配置；未能查证到官方关于多车道路段范围的说明。

timeline.en: A sinkhole opens on WV 20 in Hinton in June after an old drainage structure collapses.
timeline.zh: 6 月，欣顿的 WV 20 因旧排水结构坍塌出现塌陷坑。

timeline.en: WVDOH takes bids on 12 September for a permanent rerouting of Brier Branch under the road.
timeline.zh: 9 月 12 日，西弗吉尼亚公路局就将布莱尔支流永久改道至路下的工程招标。
